annotations.text:
A - FRONTIER INSTRUMENT
Instrument Serif + IBM Plex Mono. Near-black, one acid accent. The stack drawn as a diagram, cost flowing upward.
+ Institutional and technical at once. Closest to a fund founders take seriously on first look.
- Editorial serif on near-black is the most-copied AI-fund look right now; the accent carries all the differentiation.

B - MACHINE VISION
Phosphor CRT, all-mono, headline visibly split into tokens, dither texture, terminal syntax as navigation.
+ Unmistakable to researchers - signals we live in the same tools they do. Nobody else in VC looks like this.
- Highest risk of aging fast, and it fights long Chinese copy: 中文 in mono at 12px is genuinely hard to read.

C - PAPER CONTRARIAN
Pure white, no dark mode, 118px Archivo Black against 10px mono, visible ruled grid, one red.
+ The boldest move available when every AI brand is dark and glowing. Prints and screenshots beautifully.
- Reads more design studio than fund; the huge type leaves little room for the dense content you actually have.

D - LATENT CARTOGRAPHY
The brand is a coordinate system. Space Grotesk + DM Mono, cool paper, indigo and the IOSG magenta. Thesis and portfolio are both plotted, not listed.
+ Most extensible: every new company, thesis and event gets a position. Keeps visual continuity with IOSG.
- Charts need real maintenance, and a wrongly-placed dot is an argument with a founder.

E - COMPUTE AS MATERIAL
Graphite and steel, thermal amber, Barlow Condensed. The three layers are rack units; portfolio companies are dies on a wafer.
+ Physical and heavy - the opposite of AI abstraction. Strong for the compute layer and hardware mandate.
- The metaphor is bottom-of-stack; it undersells Layer 3, and condensed caps get shouty at length.
